why.zh: 一个让 AI 编程代理「少写代码」的技能包：在真实 FastAPI + React 仓库的 12 个功能任务上实测，代码量平均减少约 54%（最高 94%），成本降约 20%、速度提升约 27%，且保留了全部安全防护。主打「资深工程师式克制」，兼容 Claude Code 等 20 个 agent，一周内以日均 750+ star 的速度引爆。
why.en: A skill pack that makes AI coding agents write less code: benchmarked on 12 real tasks in a FastAPI + React repo, it cuts code volume by ~54% on average (up to 94%), ~20% cost and ~27% faster, while keeping all safety guards. Its 'senior engineer restraint' philosophy works with 20 agents including Claude Code, and it exploded at 750+ stars/day this week.

highlights.zh: 有完整可复现的基准测试（benchmarks/ 目录），不是纯营销数字
highlights.en: Ships a fully reproducible benchmark (benchmarks/ directory), not just marketing numbers

highlights.zh: npm 一行安装，兼容 20+ 编码代理（Claude Code、Cursor 等）
highlights.en: One-line npm install, compatible with 20+ coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.)

highlights.zh: MIT 协议，产品化程度高（logo、多语言文档、waitlist）
highlights.en: MIT licensed, highly productized (branding, i18n docs, waitlist)

cons.zh: 收益依赖任务类型：代码本已精简的场景提升接近于零
cons.en: Gains depend on task type: near zero where code is already minimal

fitFor.zh: 觉得 AI 生成的代码过度设计的开发者
fitFor.en: Developers tired of AI over-building

fitFor.zh: 控制 LLM 编码成本的团队
fitFor.en: Teams optimizing LLM coding costs

why.zh: 「给你的 AI Agent 一键装上互联网能力」：为 agent 提供搜索、社交媒体（含 B 站）、内容抓取等网络接口的统一接入层，替你选好、装好、体检好最稳的接入方式并随平台换代自动升级。曾登 GitHub Trending 日榜 #1，本周再获 5100+ star。
why.en: 'One-click internet superpowers for your AI agent': a unified integration layer giving agents web search, social media (incl. Bilibili) and content-scraping capabilities. It picks, installs and health-checks the most stable integration for you and upgrades automatically as platforms change. A former GitHub Trending #1 of the day, adding 5,100+ stars this week.

highlights.zh: CLI + Claude Code/Cursor 插件双形态，开箱即用
highlights.en: Both a CLI and Claude Code/Cursor plugins, ready out of the box

highlights.zh: 中文开发者主导，文档覆盖中/英/日/韩四语
highlights.en: Led by a Chinese developer, docs in Chinese/English/Japanese/Korean

highlights.zh: 接入方式平台化封装，平台改版不需要用户操心
highlights.en: Integrations are platformized — platform redesigns don't break your setup

cons.zh: 依赖第三方平台接口，长期稳定性存在不确定性
cons.en: Relies on third-party platform APIs; long-term stability is uncertain

fitFor.zh: 需要让本地 agent 联网获取实时信息的用户
fitFor.en: Users who want local agents to fetch live web info

fitFor.zh: 做多平台内容聚合/监控的自动化玩家
fitFor.en: Automators aggregating content across platforms

why.zh: 逐字收录 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、Grok 等主流 AI 产品的系统提示词（泄露原文），并持续更新：本月已跟进 Claude Code headless（Fable 5.1）、Codex GPT-6-Astra 等。被《华盛顿邮报》用于制作交互报道，被 CEPS AI World 做成数据看板——是研究各家 agent 行为约束的第一手语料库。
why.en: A verbatim archive of leaked system prompts from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok and other major AI products, continuously updated — this month alone it tracked Claude Code headless (Fable 5.1) and Codex GPT-6-Astra. Cited by The Washington Post for an interactive story and turned into a live dashboard by CEPS' AI World: the first-hand corpus for studying how AI vendors constrain their agents.

highlights.zh: 更新极快，几乎与新模型发布同步
highlights.en: Extremely fast updates, nearly in sync with new model releases

highlights.zh: 按厂商/产品分目录组织，检索友好
highlights.en: Organized by vendor/product directories, easy to navigate

highlights.zh: 已被主流媒体与学术机构引用
highlights.en: Already cited by major media and research institutions

cons.zh: 内容为泄露性质，合规与可用性风险需自行评估
cons.en: Content is leaked material; compliance and availability risks are on you

fitFor.zh: 研究 prompt 工程与 agent 约束设计的工程师
fitFor.en: Engineers studying prompt engineering and agent guardrail design

fitFor.zh: 对比各家产品行为差异的分析者
fitFor.en: Analysts comparing cross-vendor agent behavior

why.zh: DeepSeek 官方开源的 agent 运行时（dsh），本周 +4720 star。核心是「一切皆插件」架构，底层基于 Cordis 并附论文《A Programming Paradigm for Spatiotemporal Composability》。`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web` 一条命令即可在本地 3080 端口拉起完整 Web UI。头部实验室下场做 agent 基础设施，值得重点关注。
why.en: DeepSeek's official open-source agent harness (dsh), +4,720 stars this week. Its core is an 'everything-is-a-plugin' architecture built on Cordis, with an accompanying paper on 'A Programming Paradigm for Spatiotemporal Composability'. One command (`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`) boots a full local Web UI on port 3080. A top lab shipping agent infrastructure deserves close attention.

highlights.zh: 大厂官方出品 + 学术论文背书，工程与理论双支撑
highlights.en: Official release from a major lab, backed by an academic paper

highlights.zh: 插件化架构天然利于生态扩展（dsh-plugin 话题已上线）
highlights.en: Plugin architecture favors ecosystem growth (dsh-plugin topic already live)

highlights.zh: 提供 Web UI、SSH、无头多种运行形态与官方文档站
highlights.en: Multiple run modes (Web UI, SSH, headless) plus an official docs site

cons.zh: 仍处 developer preview，明确警告会有破坏性变更
cons.en: Still in developer preview with explicit breaking-change warnings

fitFor.zh: 想研究一线 agent harness 设计的工程师
fitFor.en: Engineers studying state-of-the-art agent harness design

fitFor.zh: 想自建 agent 平台而非拼凑框架的团队
fitFor.en: Teams building their own agent platform instead of gluing frameworks

why.zh: 自定位为「agent harness 操作系统」：围绕 Claude Code 等编码 agent 提供组织化管理层——GitHub App、官网 ecc.tools、活跃 Discord 社区与 13 种语言的文档一应俱全。产品化速度和社区运营是其一周 +3480 star 的主要推手。
why.en: Self-described as the 'operating system for agent harnesses': an orchestration layer around coding agents like Claude Code, complete with a GitHub App, a website (ecc.tools), an active Discord, and docs in 13 languages. Rapid productization and community ops drove its +3,480 stars this week.

highlights.zh: GitHub App 形态接入，对团队协作场景友好
highlights.en: Integrates as a GitHub App, friendly to team workflows

highlights.zh: 本地化覆盖 13 种语言，国际化程度罕见地高
highlights.en: Localized in 13 languages — unusually thorough internationalization

highlights.zh: MIT 协议 + 官网 + 社区，商业化路径清晰
highlights.en: MIT license + website + community: a clear commercialization path

cons.zh: 生态尚新，与既有工具链的整合深度有待观察
cons.en: Young ecosystem; depth of integration with existing toolchains remains to be seen

fitFor.zh: 管理多个编码 agent 的团队负责人
fitFor.en: Team leads coordinating multiple coding agents

fitFor.zh: 想给 Claude Code 加管理层的重度用户
fitFor.en: Power users wanting a management layer over Claude Code

why.zh: 100+ 个可运行的开源 AI agent / RAG 应用合集，全部 Apache-2.0，覆盖从「项目墓园解剖师」这类趣味 agent 到保险理赔语音 agent 团队等实战场景，兼容 Claude/Gemini/GPT/DeepSeek/Qwen。每周持续上新，是学做 agent 应用最实用的代码库。
why.en: A collection of 100+ runnable open-source AI agent and RAG apps, all Apache-2.0 — from fun ones like the 'Project Graveyard' autopsier to production-grade teams like a live insurance-claim voice agent squad — compatible with Claude/Gemini/GPT/DeepSeek/Qwen. Updated weekly; the most practical code base for learning agent development.

highlights.zh: 每个示例端到端测试过，clone 即跑
highlights.en: Every example is end-to-end tested — clone and run

highlights.zh: 分类清晰：单 agent / 多 agent / 语音 / RAG / agent skills
highlights.en: Clean taxonomy: single-agent / multi-agent / voice / RAG / agent skills

highlights.zh: Apache-2.0，可商用作学习模板
highlights.en: Apache-2.0: usable as commercial learning templates

cons.zh: 数量庞大但深度不一，需自行甄别示例质量
cons.en: Huge count with uneven depth; quality varies per example

fitFor.zh: 寻找可改造起点的 agent 应用开发者
fitFor.en: Agent developers looking for a starting point to fork

fitFor.zh: 教学/培训场景的实战素材库
fitFor.en: Educators needing hands-on material

why.zh: 免费 AI 网关：把 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Cline、Copilot 等 356 家服务商的模型收敛到一个端点，其中 150+ 免费档位经去重计算后约每月 14.7 亿免费 token，自动故障转移 + 19 种路由策略，还有平均约 89% 的 token 压缩。对被额度限制折磨的开发者是刚需型项目。
why.en: The free AI gateway: one endpoint fronting 356 providers for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Cline and Copilot — 150+ free tiers totaling ~1.47B free tokens/month (deduplicated), auto-fallback, 19 routing strategies, and token compression averaging ~89%. A must-have for anyone fighting rate limits.

highlights.zh: 免费额度目录化 + 预算仪表盘，数字算得明明白白
highlights.en: Cataloged free tiers + budget dashboard with transparent math

highlights.zh: 对标商业网关（LiteLLM/OpenRouter）的自托管替代
highlights.en: A self-hosted alternative benchmarked against LiteLLM/OpenRouter

highlights.zh: 带完整 dashboard 截图与架构图，文档投入大
highlights.en: Full dashboard screenshots and architecture diagrams — serious docs effort

cons.zh: 免费档位政策变动频繁，维护负担重
cons.en: Free-tier policies churn often — heavy maintenance burden

fitFor.zh: 多工具并用、想统一端点与路由的重度 AI 用户
fitFor.en: Heavy AI users unifying endpoints across many tools

fitFor.zh: 预算敏感的个人开发者与小团队
fitFor.en: Budget-sensitive indie developers and small teams

why.zh: AI 时代的数据基础设施常青树：为 LLM 提供规模化网页搜索、抓取与交互 API，自动输出 markdown/结构化数据，已处理数十亿页面。老牌项目本周仍以 +2232 star 增速上榜，说明 agent 抓数据的需求仍在指数增长。
why.en: The evergreen data infrastructure of the AI era: a scale API for web search, scraping and interaction for LLMs, emitting markdown/structured data, having processed billions of pages. A veteran project still gaining +2,232 stars this week — proof that agents' appetite for web data keeps compounding.

highlights.zh: Python/Node SDK + MCP server，agent 接入零门槛
highlights.en: Python/Node SDKs + MCP server: zero-friction agent integration

highlights.zh: 开源可自托管 + 云服务双模式
highlights.en: Open-source self-hostable, plus a managed cloud

highlights.zh: 处理 JS 渲染页、反爬与结构化提取能力强
highlights.en: Strong on JS-rendered pages, anti-bot handling and structured extraction

cons.zh: 云服务收费，重度使用成本需评估
cons.en: Cloud tier is paid; heavy usage costs need estimating

fitFor.zh: 给 agent 提供实时网页上下文的 RAG/搜索应用
fitFor.en: RAG/search apps feeding agents live web context

fitFor.zh: 批量内容提取管线
fitFor.en: Bulk content-extraction pipelines

why.zh: 「第一个开源的 agentic 视频生产系统」：粘贴一个你喜欢的视频，agent 团队即可解析其结构并驱动 ffmpeg、ElevenLabs 等供应商完成成片生产，GitHub Trending 日榜 #1。多模态 agent 从对话走向实际生产力工具的标志性项目，本周 +2105 star。
why.en: 'The first open-source agentic video production system': paste a video you love and an agent team parses its structure, then drives providers like ffmpeg and ElevenLabs to produce finished cuts. #1 on GitHub Trending of the day — a landmark project taking multimodal agents from chat to real production, +2,105 stars this week.

highlights.zh: 视频生产全流程 agent 化：脚本、剪辑、配音、字幕
highlights.en: Full video pipeline agentized: scripting, editing, voiceover, subtitles

highlights.zh: 供应商可插拔（见 docs/PROVIDERS.md），不锁定单一模型
highlights.en: Pluggable providers (docs/PROVIDERS.md), no single-model lock-in

highlights.zh: 自带 mascot、网站与 prompt 示例库，社区氛围好
highlights.en: Ships mascot, website and a prompt library — strong community vibes

cons.zh: AGPLv3 协议对商用集成较严格
cons.en: AGPLv3 is restrictive for commercial integration

cons.zh: 视频生成依赖付费供应商额度
cons.en: Video generation depends on paid provider quotas

fitFor.en: Creators exploring automated video workflows

fitFor.zh: 研究多模态 agent 协作的工程师
fitFor.en: Engineers researching multimodal agent collaboration

why.zh: 「一个装在口袋里的 AI 代理公司」：精心设计的专家型 agent 人格合集——从前端专家到 Reddit 社区运营、从「奇思妙想注入器」到「现实检验员」，每个角色都有个性、流程与交付物模板，一键装进 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Gemini。已推出 macOS/Win/Linux 原生 App，本周 +1603 star。
why.en: An AI agency in your pocket: a curated roster of specialist agent personas — from frontend wizards to Reddit community ninjas, from 'whimsy injectors' to 'reality checkers' — each with personality, processes and deliverable templates, one-click installable into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Gemini. Now with a native macOS/Win/Linux app; +1,603 stars this week.

highlights.zh: 角色设计细致到流程与交付物，可直接落地使用
highlights.en: Personas detailed down to processes and deliverables — immediately usable

highlights.zh: 原生 App 免配置安装与自动更新
highlights.en: Native app installs without config and auto-updates

highlights.zh: MIT 协议，源自 Reddit 社区迭代
highlights.en: MIT licensed, community-iterated from a Reddit thread

cons.zh: 人格化 prompt 收益因人而异，效果难量化
cons.en: Persona prompts deliver uneven gains; hard to quantify

fitFor.en: Individuals/teams wanting role-specialized agents
